title: Temple History
content: History of Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha, Yelahanka.
established: The temple was established to honor Sri Raghavendra Swamy, a 17th-century saint and philosopher of the Madhwa tradition.
significance: Sri Raghavendra Swamy (1595–1671) was a renowned saint, scholar, and devotee of Lord Vishnu. He took Samadhi in 1671 at this location, which is considered a sacred Brindavana.

timeline.event: Birth of Sri Raghavendra Swamy in Baskarigram
Sri Raghavendra Swamy takes Diksha from Sri Suyam Prakasha Swamy
Establishment of the Matha at Yelahanka

architecture: The temple features traditional Dravidian architecture with intricate carvings and a beautiful Rajagopuram (entrance tower).

festivals.name: Mukkoti Ekadashi
festivals.description: Most important Ekadashi, attracts thousands of devotees

festivals.name: Raghavendra Aradhana
festivals.description: Annual festival commemorating the saint's Samadhi
